why_ai: Crews must acquire data on site and a signing geophysicist owns the anomaly call, though processing and picking increasingly automate.
why_clarity: Methods are standardised, but whether an interpretation was right surfaces only when someone else excavates or drills.
why_digital: Starts from physical ground and field crews and ends as digital maps and volumes sold to regional and national clients.

why_ai: Field crews are physical and velocity judgement is skilled, but processing automates and demand rides commodity cycles.
why_clarity: Production is measurable in the field, but image quality is judged by eye and tested by wells much later.
why_digital: Physical recording feeds an all-digital processing chain, bought by a few concentrated energy clients.

why_ai: Laying out and recording hundreds of thousands of channels across ranches is hands-on field work no software performs.
why_clarity: Points recorded per day against a bid is an exact, daily-checked measure on a repeatable crew routine.
why_digital: Physical crews and vibrators on private land deliver digital recordings to a few concentrated clients.

why_ai: Screen work increasingly done by inversion and machine learning, though velocity-model judgement remains skilled.
why_clarity: Flows are codified, but image quality is judged by eye and tested by wells months or years later.
why_digital: Traces in, images out, all compute, with processing houses serving clients worldwide.

why_ai: Technicians must sweep corridors with EM and GPR on site, and sealed SUE deliverables carry liability.
why_clarity: ASCE 38 quality levels define the deliverable and QL-A test holes check it within weeks.
why_digital: Physical corridors scanned on foot, delivered as CAD to DOTs that hire local on-call firms.

why_ai: Access is negotiated face to face with landowners; the relationship is the product.
why_clarity: Permit rate is measurable, but every negotiation is a different person and the method is personal.
why_digital: Door-to-door negotiation and paper permits on rural land, local by nature.

why_ai: Handling decaying tapes and paper takes hands, but scanning, vectorising and navigation recovery automate.
why_clarity: A rescued line either loads with correct navigation and ties or it does not.
why_digital: Paper sections and tapes in, SEG-Y and navigation files out, sold to libraries and surveys anywhere.

why_ai: Field surveys in remote terrain, qualified-person disclosure and trusted targeting advice protect the work.
why_clarity: Targeting methods vary by interpreter and drill results arrive months later, often inconclusive.
why_digital: Physical ground surveys become digital inversions and maps, sold across borders to juniors.

why_ai: On-site scanning of sacred ground for communities that must trust the interpreter, with contested, consequential calls.
why_clarity: Burial calls are rarely ground-truthed and confidence language has no agreed standard.
why_digital: Physical survey of cemeteries delivered as maps and in-person community meetings.

why_ai: Sensors must cross hazardous ranges and accredited organisations answer for missed munitions, though classification itself automates.
why_clarity: Every dig verifies a call against a fixed zero-miss acceptance rule.
why_digital: Field EM data from physical ranges, inverted on screen and bought through federal task orders.

why_ai: A technician must scan the slab on site before the core and is liable for a cut tendon.
why_clarity: Each core confirms or refutes the marks, on thousands of near-identical slabs.
why_digital: Handheld scanning of a physical slab, delivered as paint marks to local contractors.

why_ai: Owned data rather than labour is the moat; imaging and licensing automate, but deep libraries are slow to replicate.
why_clarity: Licensing is routine, but image quality is judged by eye and tested by wells drilled years later.
why_digital: Digital volumes licensed remotely to E&P companies worldwide.

why_ai: Risk sign-off carries accountability and depends on trusted specialists reading historical archives.
why_clarity: Desk studies follow a documented method and recur, but outcomes surface only when targets are investigated.
why_digital: Archive research and survey data reviewed on screen, delivered as reports to developers abroad.

why_ai: Hazard analyses for critical facilities are signed by accountable engineers and reviewed by regulators.
why_clarity: Methods are codified, but each site is bespoke and the true hazard is known only after earthquakes, if ever.
why_digital: Field velocity measurements feed screen-based analysis and digital reports.

why_ai: Array installation is field work and magnitude calls feed regulatory action, but event detection automates.
why_clarity: Event locations and magnitudes are checkable against catalogues within hours.
why_digital: Sensor networks stream data, and analysis and reporting are remote.

why_ai: Multi-sensor collection still needs field crews, but the business model is automating the interpretation itself.
why_clarity: Maps are checked against excavation on customer projects.
why_digital: Field sensor data fused by software and delivered as digital models to owners nationwide.

why_ai: Low-level flying with specialised aircraft and crews is physical and regulated; processing automates.
why_clarity: Survey specifications and QC are codified and repeat across flights.
why_digital: Aircraft collect over physical terrain and processed grids are delivered digitally worldwide.

why_ai: Observers must stand watch at sea and call shutdowns under permit rules, though acoustic detection automates.
why_clarity: Permit rules define exclusion zones and reporting, and detections are logged and checkable.
why_digital: Visual watch at sea and acoustic monitoring, delivered as digital reports.

why_ai: Clients pay for a trusted interpreter's targeting judgement, though inversion and anomaly picking automate.
why_clarity: Interpretation styles differ and drill outcomes arrive late and noisy.
why_digital: Client data in, models and reports out, sold remotely across borders.

why_ai: Prospect decisions are high-stakes, novel and slow to verify, made by teams accountable for capital.
why_clarity: Each prospect is distinct and its outcome is known only after drilling.
why_digital: Data and models on screen, with decisions delivered internally.

why_ai: Statutory authority over permits and lease bids must be exercised by federal staff.
why_clarity: Bid evaluation follows written procedures, but resource estimates are tested only by later drilling.
why_digital: Seismic and well data analysed on screen under a federal, non-market jurisdiction.

why_ai: Software features are what AI-native tools and coding assistants compete with most directly.
why_clarity: Algorithms are testable against benchmark data and releases recur.
why_digital: Code in, software out, sold globally online.

why_ai: Public mapping programs carry federal authority and fly physical surveys through contractors.
why_clarity: Survey specifications are standardised and QC is objective, though mineral-potential outcomes are slow.
why_digital: Airborne data over physical terrain, published free online by public agencies.

why_ai: Pricing a stream on an unbuilt mine is a high-stakes, adversarial judgement made by accountable experts.
why_clarity: Each deal is unique and its outcome plays out over the life of the mine.
why_digital: Data rooms and models on screen, with deals sourced through global relationships.

why_ai: Acquisition decisions are relationship-driven and consequential; the analysis supports dealmakers.
why_clarity: Each acquisition is distinct and integration success shows over years.
why_digital: Financial data analysed on screen, but deals need visits and relationships with local owners.

why_ai: Trusted intermediaries and valuation opinions carry personal reputation in thin, private markets.
why_clarity: Most seismic data has no public price, so value is argued case by case.
why_digital: Licences and data rooms handled remotely within a small network of buyers.

why_ai: Standards and advocacy draw authority from member consensus, not from the text.
why_clarity: Committees follow process, but influence and research value are hard to measure.
why_digital: Publications and standards are digital; conferences and lobbying are in person.
